_comment: Cantrip item 1 (2026-10-28): THE SHUFFLE LINE (USER 2026-10-27: 'use Brainstorm or Brainsurge to throw away bad cards
with a shuffle, such as from a fetchland ... We need to support playing the fetch lands after the brainstorm to do
this'). Round 2, main 1, the land drop unused: Island + Steam Vents out; Brainstorm, two Toxic Deluges (dead),
Scalding Tarn, Street Wraith and Emrakul in hand -- NO Unpredictable Cyclone (a missing piece; go-off 2+ draws away).
The library top is Cyclone, Ponder, Remand (no land), then Mountains (and a Steam Vents + an Emrakul at the bottom).
The line: cast Brainstorm (draws the Cyclone), put back the two Deluges (the scored order ranks this dump FIRST only
because a shuffle follows), THEN play the Tarn and crack it (Steam Vents) -- the shuffle takes the Deluges away, the
round-3 and round-4 draws are lands, and round 4 casts Cyclone and cycles the Wraith into the library Emrakul.
Playing the Tarn first shuffles the Cyclone away before the Brainstorm; skipping the shuffle leaves both Deluges as
the next two draws (no fifth land). Asserted on the game log at the shipped play budget (d5 b20).
expect_log_sequence: REVEAL Brainstorm (put back): Toxic Deluge, Toxic Deluge
